subject: Graduate Engineer (Hall Contracting): Marc Darenz Masarate
email_body:
Hello,

I am applying through SEEK for the Graduate Engineer roles at Hall Contracting (job 95232723).

In February 2026 I finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design, with road, earthworks, pavement and stormwater design in Civil 3D and AutoCAD. From 2019 to 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines as a field engineer and project-in-charge. I am based in Melton VIC, hold a White Card, a licence and my own transport, and have full working rights to December 2027 on a 485 visa. I am available for site, regional and FIFO work.

The pathway from the Sunshine Coast office into FIFO site engineering on marine, dredging and civil infrastructure is the kind of mentored delivery work I want to learn. I do not yet have Australian marine construction experience.

Would you be open to considering my application? I've attached my resume and cover letter.

Kind regards,

letter.subject: Application for Graduate Engineer (SEEK 95232723)
paragraphs: I am applying for the Graduate Engineer roles at Hall Contracting, advertised on SEEK as job 95232723. The pathway from office mobilisation and planning into FIFO site engineering on marine, dredging and civil infrastructure is the mentored delivery work I am looking for.

In February 2026 I completed an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design at the Albright Institute of Business and Language. I designed and documented road geometry, earthworks, pavement systems and stormwater drainage, and prepared and reviewed drawings in AutoCAD and Civil 3D to Australian Standards. I also hold a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering from Divine Word College of Legazpi (2014 to 2019).

From April 2019 to February 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines. As project-in-charge on a community hall renovation I coordinated 10 to 15 workers each day, reviewed drawings and carried out site inspections, safety checks and quality monitoring. As a field engineer on subdivision finishing works I prepared site reports, material records and progress reports and worked with engineers, subcontractors and suppliers.

I do not yet have Australian marine or dredging project experience, and I currently live in Melton rather than Brisbane or the Sunshine Coast. I am open to discussing relocation for the right role, hold a White Card, an Australian driver's licence and my own transport, and have full working rights until December 2027 on a Subclass 485 visa.
I have attached my resume. Thank you for considering my application.

checklist: Open https://www.seek.com.au/job/95232723 and confirm the Graduate Engineer advert is still open.
Upload the resume and cover letter PDFs from this pack.
Confirm right to work: Subclass 485 with full working rights to December 2027.
Do not claim Australian marine or dredging experience, or that Marc already lives in Brisbane or the Sunshine Coast.
After the SEEK receipt arrives, press Applied on this record with the date.
notes: SEEK is the advertised route. No employer-published direct application email found for this advert.
